## Mission check
<!-- Every PR answers these six questions. A PR that cannot is not ready for review. -->
1. Which mission objective (1 to 6) does this support?
2. What existing capability (repository, module, library) can be reused, and what did you reuse?
3. What business problem does it solve, in one sentence?
4. What measurable result is expected (which Overview figure changes, from what to what)?
5. How will completion be verified (test, owner check, real data)?
6. What remains unknown or unverified?

## What changed
<!-- Plain words. What was added, changed or removed. -->

## Completion evidence
<!-- "Code written" or "page renders" is not complete. Tick only what is true and show the evidence. -->
- [ ] Implementation done
- [ ] Tests added or updated, and the full suite passes (paste the result line)
- [ ] Acceptance criteria met (link or list them)
- [ ] Evidence of successful operation (output, screenshot or owner check)
- [ ] Documentation updated
- [ ] Production status stated below

**Production status:** <!-- Not deployed / Awaiting owner approval / Deployed (date) -->

## Safety
- [ ] No secrets, tokens or connection strings in code, docs or this description
- [ ] No production change, merge or deploy without owner approval
- [ ] No fabricated progress, metrics, revenue or health (unknown stays unknown)
